output.narrative: The ecpm metric experienced a downward move of -0.0243, driven primarily by ecpm. Within category, the drop was heavily concentrated in category=finance, which showed a lift of 13.75 and an explanatory power of 0.988 (ruled out category=social with a lift of -0.37). Drilling deeper into category=finance, the decline was further concentrated in ad_format=video, backed by a lift of 2.69 and an explanatory power of 0.356 (while ad_format=banner was ruled out with a lift of 0.2).
